subject: MPA & signature sequencing — Nexara procurement / legal coordination
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@nexarahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MPA & signature sequencing — Nexara procurement / legal coordination

Hi Sam + Maria,

Quick note to align the MAP and the legal/procurement sequencing so we can hit Nexara's target signature window. We put together a concise mutual action plan to make dependencies explicit (MSA, DPA, order form). Key asks from our side:
- Legal review window: 5 business days for first-pass redlines, then a 48–72 hour follow-up for sign-off on limited redlines.
- Evidence: SOC 2 summary + operational artifact bundle (see attachment list).
- Procurement: PO lead-time and billing contact so we can reserve dedicated capacity if needed.

I've attached a working MAP (v1) to start. Can you confirm:
1) Who at Nexara will own the PO and procurement timeline?
2) Any internal security reviewers beyond Maria who need the SOC 2 packet?
3) Is an escrow or data-residency addendum required for legal?

Goal: synchronized timeline that gets us to an executed MSA + DPA + order form within a 2–3 week fast-track if all evidence and PO land promptly.

Thanks — I’ll consolidate answers into MAP v2.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Nexara_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@nexarahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nexarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & signature sequencing — Nexara procurement / legal coordination

Kim — thanks for the clear ask.

Answers inline:
1) Procurement/PO owner: I’ll own the request and loop in procurement if we need a formal PO. Likely timeline from my side: internal approvals 3–5 business days, then procurement runs 5–7 business days once we push to them.
2) Security reviewers: Maria (cc’d) is lead; we may also loop in our InfoSec engineer (Arun K.). I’ll confirm whether they need the full SOC 2 artifacts or a redacted summary.
3) Escrow/addendum: Not required for core data residency, but Legal is asking about a short escrow clause for IP in case of long-term outages — I’ll surface the language.

We’re motivated to move quickly — plan on a short review this week if we have the SOC 2 summary and the MAP with explicit milestone owners.

—Sam
Sam Thompson
Head of Procurement & Strategic Sourcing
Nexara Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@nexarahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nexarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & signature sequencing — Nexara procurement / legal coordination

Sam — great, thanks. Attached is MAP v2 (condensed) with milestone owners and recommended legal/operational evidence. Highlights:
- Week 0 (today): MAP v2 shared 
- Days 1–3: Nexara legal first-pass (we ask for redlines in a single tracked doc)
- Days 4–7: Redwood legal comment resolution + final DPA tweaks (48–72h turn)
- Days 7–10: Order form finalization and PO initiation (Sam)
- Days 10–14: Procurement processing + signature target (goal: executed MSA/DPA/Order Form by Aug 2).

Critical blockers we can remove quickly: SOC 2 summary (attached), evidence for retention & deletion controls, and the billing contact for PO.

Attachments included: Nexara_MAP_v2.xlsx (single-sheet milestones), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf.

Please review the MAP v2 and mark the milestone owners you want changed; I’ll produce a version we can attach to the HubSpot deal record.

Link to HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-98765

—Kim
[Attachment: Nexara_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@nexarahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nexarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & signature sequencing — Nexara procurement / legal coordination

Hi all — quick procurement sequencing note from Redwood billing/procurement perspective:
- If Nexara is doing a PO: typical processing is 5–7 business days once procurement receives the PO and vendor packet. Please send to billing@redwood.ai and cc me so we can prioritize.
- Billing packet: W9, vendor details (we can provision a temporary invoice while docs finalize).
- Escrow/IP language: we can accept a short, limited escrow clause; Legal will want to confirm the exact trigger and holder. That review usually adds 2 business days.

I’ve attached a procurement checklist you can drop into the MAP as an appendix — it helps set expectations for handoffs and SLA language.

Action items for Nexara: share procurement contact + expected PO date; if PO is >30 days out we’ll need to provision temporary reserve capacity pricing.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sam Thompson <sam.thompson@nexarahealth.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nexarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-23T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & signature sequencing — Nexara procurement / legal coordination

Thanks everyone — squaring a few operational checks: 
- Acceptance gating: we’ll use the MAP's acceptance checklist for the pilot (basic smoke tests + data handling assertions). Estimated staging window is 3 business days once order form is signed.
- Dedicated capacity: if Nexara requests reserved capacity, provisioning lead time is 7 business days post-PO; we can start a warm-up reservation if a billing authorization is provided earlier.
- Evidence: Maria, please confirm if the SOC 2 summary is sufficient or if InfoSec needs the full artifact bundle. If they need the full bundle, flag that as it changes review time.

Once Sam confirms procurement contact and expected PO date, I’ll lock the MAP milestones and publish a final MAP v3 to the HubSpot record and share a DocuSign envelope placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/link/abcdef123456

Looking forward to getting this into a signed state — low friction on our side as long as evidence and the PO are timely.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
